exercises.description:
Exercise: Strings Basics

Work with ASCII and UTF-8 strings in Move.

Stuck? Check out: https://move-book.com/move-basics/string.html

Common operations:
- string::utf8(bytes) - create UTF-8 string from bytes
- ascii::string(bytes) - create ASCII string from bytes
- string::length(s) - get length
- string::is_empty(s) - check if empty
- string::append(s1, s2) - concatenate strings
- string::as_bytes(s) - get underlying bytes

Your task:
Implement basic string operations using Move's string module.

exercises.name: tx_context1
exercises.hint:
create_proposal: Set deadline_epoch = tx_context::epoch(ctx) + duration_epochs
sign_proposal: Use vector::contains to check duplicates, vector::push_back to add signers
execute_proposal: Check if vector::length(&signers) >= required_signatures
verify_signature_time_window: Loop through signature_epochs to find min/max
Stuck? Check out: https://move-book.com/programmability/transaction-context.html
exercises.description:
Exercise: Transaction Context - Multi-Sig Timestamp System

Build a multi-signature system that tracks when each signer approves,
with time windows for validity using transaction context.

Stuck? Check out: https://move-book.com/programmability/transaction-context.html

exercises.name: tx_context2
exercises.hint:
mint_nft: Use tx_context::epoch() and tx_context::epoch_timestamp_ms() to track creation
transfer_nft: Update current_owner and increment transfer_count
evolve_nft: Calculate age = current_epoch - created_epoch. Stages: 0-4→0, 5-9→1, 10-19→2, 20+→3
power_up: Only allow if last_transfer_epoch < current_epoch (once per epoch)
Stuck? Check out: https://move-book.com/programmability/transaction-context.html
exercises.description:
Exercise: Transaction Context - Dynamic NFT Evolution

Create NFTs that evolve based on transaction context (epoch, transfers, ownership time).
NFTs "age" and change attributes over time using epoch tracking.

Stuck? Check out: https://move-book.com/programmability/transaction-context.html

exercises.name: tx_context3
exercises.hint:
create_escrow: Use tx_context::fresh_object_address(ctx) for unique escrow_address
release_funds: Check if current_epoch >= locked_until_epoch AND approved (if required)
cancel_escrow: Only allow if current_epoch < locked_until_epoch - 1 (at least 1 epoch before unlock)
approve_release: Only approver can call, check if not already approved
Stuck? Check out: https://move-book.com/programmability/transaction-context.html
exercises.description:
Exercise: Transaction Context - Time-Locked Escrow

Build an escrow system with time locks using epoch-based constraints.
Use fresh_object_address for unique escrow IDs and epoch timing for releases.

Stuck? Check out: https://move-book.com/programmability/transaction-context.html
